channel.description: Last 10 notes on Dong Xing's Blog

item.title: Newton's Method for Polynomial Powers
item.description: Newton’s Method for Polynomial Powers is an algorithm that computes f(x)^z\bmod x^n for a formal power series f(x) such that f(0)\ne0 in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Newton's Method for Polynomial Square Roots
item.description: Newton’s Method for Polynomial Square Roots is an algorithm that computes \sqrt{f(x)}\bmod x^n for a formal power series f(x) such that f(0)\ne0 in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Newton's Method for Polynomial Inversion
item.description: Newton’s Method for Polynomial Inversion is an algorithm that computes f(x)^{-1}\bmod x^n for a formal power series f(x) such that f(0)\ne0 in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Newton's Method for Polynomial Exponentiation
item.description: Newton’s Method for Polynomial Exponentiation is an algorithm that computes e^{f(x)}\bmod x^n for a formal power series f(x) such that f(0)=0 in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Newton's Method for Polynomial Logarithms
item.description: Newton’s Method for Polynomial Logarithms is an algorithm that computes \log_ef(x)\bmod x^n for a formal power series f(x) such that f(0)=1 in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Extended Euclidean Algorithm
item.description: The Extended Euclidean Algorithm is an algorithm that finds a pair of integers x and y such that ax+by=\gcd\{a,b\} for non-negative integers a and b in \mathcal{O}(\log a+\log b) time and \mathcal{O}(\log a+\log b) space.

item.title: Fast Mobius Transform
item.description: The Fast Mobius Transform is an algorithm that computes f(S)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}g(T) for a function g defined on \mathcal{P}(\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}) in \mathcal{O}(n2^n) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Aho-Corasick Automaton
item.description: The Aho-Corasick Automaton is a data structure that maintains a set S of strings in \Sigma^* by maintaining a deterministic finite automaton that accepts and only accepts strings containing a string from S as a suffix.

item.title: Bluestein's Algorithm
item.description: Bluestein’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes f(z^0),f(z^1),\dots,f(z^{m-1}) for a polynomial f(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_ix^i in \mathcal{O}((n+m)\log(n+m)) time and \mathcal{O}(n+m) space.
